plain_label.why: lost Legal's label rules: the number rounded to 2 decimals with a point, and no original in brackets

rounds_to_nearest.why: formats with 2 decimals, which rounds 1 mi up to 1,61 km, instead of cutting down to 1,60

decimal_point.why: keeps Python's decimal point instead of the comma

square_brackets.why: reads "in brackets" as square brackets: [1 mi] instead of (1 mi)
